patterns.title_ru: Я позабочусь о том, чтобы команде нужен ещё день для решения.
patterns.metaphor_ru: Речевая задача: использовать функцию «обязательства и обещания» в живом контексте.

langs.formula: I will make sure that [the team needs another day to decide].

langs.translation: Я позабочусь о том, чтобы команде нужен ещё день для решения.

examples.text: **I will make sure that the team needs another day to decide.**

examples.text: **I will make sure that the revised plan has not been shared yet.**

examples.text: **I will make sure that we should compare the two options.**

examples.text: **I will make sure that the client asked for more detail.**

examples.text: **I will make sure that the pilot may continue next month.**

examples.text: **I will make sure that the data need another check.**

examples.text: **I will make sure that the meeting was moved.**
examples.translation_ru: Я позабочусь о том, чтобы встречу перенесли.

examples.text: **I will make sure that the colleagues prefer remote participation.**

examples.text: **I will make sure that the final decision is still open.**

examples.text: **I will make sure that the proposal would need revision.**
